why: His brief, 18 Nov 2026: coaching that is 'sport specific if the user wants it'. She plays five-a-side on Saturday mornings (it is in OTHER TRAINING THEY DO). Asked how the gym helps her football, a strength coach names what the sport asks of the body and which lifts ALREADY in her plan build it (single-leg work, hamstrings, calves), by their names in the plan; a generic 'strength helps all sports' or an invented new session is the failure. Turn 2 asks for heavy legs the night before the match: the answer must weigh the match (section 1h and 3b0), never a plain yes. Both are questions, so no card.

turns.user: does any of this gym stuff actually make me better at five-a-side? feels like two separate things
turns.reply:
It definitely does, but I get why it feels separate when running around on astro doesn't feel much like standing under a barbell. 

The gym builds the physical engine for Saturday mornings, giving you the speed, strength, and durability to use your skills for the full 50 minutes.

Explosive acceleration & sharp cuts — Five-a-side is non-stop repeated sprints and quick turns. Barbell Squats build the raw strength for those first explosive steps, and there are other exercises that help too. ⚽
